name: John Thackara
bio_en: Writer and curator. Senior advisor to Design Harvests at SUES. Works on bioregioning, soil and water care, urban-rural jobs, and design for ecological restoration.
bio_zh: 作家与策展人，SUES 设计丰收项目高级顾问，研究生物区域、土壤与水的照护、城乡新职业以及服务于生态修复的设计。
provenance: John Thackara, email to Prof Lou Yongqi and Design Harvests, 20 December 2025

name: Lou Yongqi
role: Founder of Design Harvests; chairman and chief curator, World Design Cities Conference
bio_en: Leads Design Harvests, the urban-rural design programme with 18 years of practice, and chairs the World Design Cities Conference (WDCC) in Shanghai.
bio_zh: 主持设计丰收城乡设计项目（已有 18 年实践），并担任上海世界设计之都大会主席。
provenance: John Thackara, Design Harvests 3.0 Ten Ideas note, 4 April 2026

name: Jan Boelen
bio_en: Programme director of the Aral School, which curates fellowships on cultural regeneration, ecological restoration and sustainable development in the Aral Sea region.
bio_zh: 咸海学校项目总监，策划咸海地区文化复兴、生态修复与可持续发展方向的研究员项目。
provenance: John Thackara, email to Prof Lou Yongqi and Design Harvests, 19 September 2025

name: Dr Rupa Marya
organisation: Centre for Land, Food and Medicine, Trinity College Dublin
bio_en: Physician and founder of Deep Medicine Circle in California. Moved to Dublin to start the Centre for Land, Food and Medicine at Trinity College Dublin.
bio_zh: 医生，加州 Deep Medicine Circle 创始人，赴都柏林创立圣三一学院土地、食物与医学中心。
provenance: John Thackara, email to Prof Lou Yongqi and Design Harvests, 16 July 2026

name: Suchin Shu
bio_en: Activist with a Masters in Environmental Art. Heads Yunhe Forest School, which has run project-based ecological learning for eleven years.
bio_zh: 环境艺术硕士，社会行动者，主持云和森林学校，十一年来坚持项目式生态教育。
provenance: John Thackara, email to Prof Lou Yongqi and Design Harvests, 29 May 2026

name: Francesca Valsecchi
organisation: College of Design and Innovation, Tongji University
bio_en: Leads a lab at Tongji University whose work on Shanghai wetlands takes a social-ecological approach.
bio_zh: 在同济大学设计创意学院主持实验室，以社会生态视角开展上海湿地研究。
provenance: John Thackara, email to Prof Lou Yongqi and Design Harvests, 10 November 2025

name: Ezio Manzini
bio_en: Design researcher on social innovation. Discussed social innovation and bioregioning with John Thackara in a DESIS interview on design and soil care.
bio_zh: 社会创新设计研究者，曾与约翰·萨卡拉在 DESIS 访谈中讨论社会创新与生物区域。
provenance: John Thackara, email to Prof Lou Yongqi and Design Harvests, 26 April 2024

name: Andrea Paoletti
role: Project lead, Open School for Village Hosts
bio_en: Leads the Open School for Village Hosts, an Erasmus+ project on place-based rural development. Spoke at the Zhangyan Harvest Festival.
bio_zh: 主持伊拉斯谟+项目“乡村主人开放学校”，聚焦在地乡村发展，曾在张堰丰收节发言。
provenance: John Thackara, email to Prof Lou Yongqi and Design Harvests, 21 May 2023

name: Dr Alpha Lo
bio_en: Leads the Climate Water Project, which published a research programme for water cycle restoration that bridges field practice and scientific inquiry.
bio_zh: 主持气候水项目，发布连接田野实践与科学研究的水循环修复研究计划。
provenance: John Thackara, email to Prof Lou Yongqi and Design Harvests, 11 December 2025

name: Nina Isabella Moeller
bio_en: Leads UNMEASURED, a project developing qualitative indicators for agroecology such as social cohesion, cultural resilience and care relations.
bio_zh: 主持 UNMEASURED 项目，为生态农业开发社会凝聚力、文化韧性与照护关系等定性指标。
provenance: John Thackara, email to Prof Lou Yongqi and Design Harvests, 29 May 2026
